entities.name: Mary Rockwell Hook
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mary Rockwell Hook was an American architect and a pioneer for women in architecture. She worked principally from Kansas City, Missouri but designed throughout the United States. She was denied admission to the American Institute of Architects (AIA) due to her gender.
